questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to PRUDENT:
questions.explanation: Prudent means acting with care and good judgment, so 'wise' is the closest synonym.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to VICTORY:
questions.explanation: 'Defeat' is the direct opposite of 'victory', while the other options are synonyms.
'Since' is used with a specific point in time such as a year, while 'for' is used with a duration.

questions.q: Identify the error: 'Neither of the two managers were present at the meeting.'
questions.explanation: 'Neither' is singular, so the verb must be 'was', not 'were'.

questions.q: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom 'a piece of cake':
questions.explanation: The idiom 'a piece of cake' means something very easy to do.

questions.q: One of the boys ___ left his bag in the classroom.
questions.explanation: 'One of the boys' is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'has'.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to BRAVE:
questions.explanation: 'Courageous' means showing no fear, which is the same as 'brave'.

questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to ANCIENT:
questions.explanation: 'Modern' means belonging to the present time, the opposite of 'ancient'.

questions.q: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom 'to spill the beans':
questions.explanation: 'Spill the beans' means to disclose secret information by accident or too soon.

questions.q: The letter ___ yesterday by the manager.
questions.explanation: The sentence is in the passive voice in the past tense, so 'was sent' is correct.
